metadata.scenario: A customer calls to report a service complaint, indicating both poor quality and a desire to cancel if unresolved. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint, cancellation_risk.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Dorothy Henderson. I’m calling about my recent experience with the physical therapy service. Hi Dorothy, it’s nice to hear from you. What seems to be the issue? Well, I had a session two days ago, and I was really disappointed with the quality of care. I’m very sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what happened? The therapist seemed rushed and didn't really pay attention to my needs. I felt uncomfortable, and it didn't help my recovery at all. I understand how frustrating that must be. We strive for high-quality care, and I apologize for this experience. I appreciate that, but if this isn’t resolved, I might have to consider canceling my services. I completely understand your concern, Dorothy. Let’s work on resolving this right away. Thank you. I really don’t want to cancel, but I need proper care. Of course, I will personally look into this. Could you confirm if you remember the therapist's name? It was Dr. Rodriguez, I believe. Thank you for that information. I’ll follow up with him and see what we can do. I hope so. It’s been eight months, and I just want to continue my recovery smoothly. Absolutely, your recovery is our priority. I can also schedule a different therapist if you prefer. Yes, that might be a good idea. I’d feel more comfortable with someone else. I’ll make a note of that. Would you like morning visits as usual? Yes, please. Perfect. I’ll arrange for a new female therapist to visit in the morning. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help with this. You’re welcome, Dorothy. I will also check in with you after the next session to ensure everything is satisfactory. That sounds good. I just want to make sure I’m getting the care I need. I completely understand. To confirm, I’ll contact Dr. Rodriguez and arrange a new therapist for you. Yes, please do. I’ll also follow up with our Care Coordinator, Lisa, to assist with scheduling and ensure you’re satisfied. Fantastic, thank you for being so responsive. It’s my pleasure. We want to make sure you’re taken care of. I appreciate it. I’ll wait for your call about the new therapist. You bet! We’ll be in touch soon. Have a great day, Dorothy. Thank you, Margaret. You too. Goodbye. Goodbye!
